landing.title: Start renting out your car the way that fits you
landing.subtitle: Listing your first car is simple; when you need to run at a larger scale, you can upgrade to a shop and keep the same account and vehicles.

personal.title: List a personal vehicle
personal.tagline: Commission track · a good place to start
personal.body: For owners who want to rent out a personal car simply and quickly. No sign-up fee, up to {maxVehicles} vehicles, and you manage cars and trips from your Account.
personal.art: Share your car with thousands of renters
personal.offerBody: The platform fee is added to the total the renter pays. The current pilot rate is {percent}% of the rental price.

shop.title: Open a rental shop
shop.tagline: Plan track · for a professional operation
shop.body: Suited to individuals and businesses with several vehicles. You pay a plan based on fleet size and 0% platform fee per trip while the plan is active. Full tooling for vehicles, calendar, staff, branches, finance and reports.
shop.offerBody: While the plan is active. Plenty of tooling for a professional operation, built for larger fleets.
shop.cta: Learn more and create a shop

upgrade.title: Upgrade whenever you need to
upgrade.body: You can start by listing a personal vehicle and upgrade to a shop later. Your account and vehicle data stay exactly as they are.

ownerProfile.pageSubtitle: A few simple steps to get your car onto XePrime.
ownerProfile.heading: 1. Owner profile
ownerProfile.intro: A few details so renters know who is renting out the car and where to collect it. You fill this in once, for every car you list later.
ownerProfile.publicNote: Some of these details are shown publicly on XePrime.
ownerProfile.editableLater: You can change any of this later from your vehicle management area.

name.label: Owner name
name.help: This is the name renters see on your car.

phone.label: Contact phone number
phone.unverifiedTitle: This phone number is not verified yet
phone.unverifiedBody: Renters call this number at handover, so it has to be a number you actually answer. Verifying takes less than a minute.
phone.missingTitle: Your account has no phone number
phone.missingBody: Renters need a number to call at handover. Add one and enter the code we send you.

email.label: Email (optional)
email.help: Used for notifications. Not shown publicly.

bio.label: Short introduction (optional)
bio.placeholder: A little about you or your service
bio.help: For example: responsive, available 24/7, cars always clean.

aside.title: You are about to list on the XePrime marketplace

trust.title: Safe and transparent
trust.desc: Clear details build trust with renters.

support.title: Need a hand?
support.desc: The XePrime team is here to help.

validation.addressLineRequired: Enter the house number and street

wizard.savedAndSubmitted: Vehicle saved and submitted for review
wizard.draftExists: The vehicle is already saved — trying again continues on that vehicle instead of creating a new one.
wizard.signInTitle: Sign in to list a vehicle
wizard.signInBody: Listing a vehicle needs an account so we can reach you and pay out rentals.
wizard.forbiddenBody: Your account is not allowed to add vehicles in this shop.

errors.energyRequired: Please fill in the specs required for the selected energy source.

info.plateHint: The plate number is checked against the vehicle documents during review.
info.nameHelp: This is the name renters see on the marketplace.
info.descriptionHelp: Optional, but a clear description helps renters decide faster.

rental.priceHint: This price applies to every day. You can set day-specific prices on the vehicle calendar later.
rental.discountHint: A percentage off the daily price.
rental.autoAcceptHint: Automatically confirm valid requests. Fine-tune it later in vehicle management.
rental.addressHint: Default hand-over address, taken from the branch that holds the vehicle.
rental.addressLoadError: Could not load your branches. Try again in a moment.
rental.deliveryHint: Deliver the vehicle to the renter within the radius you choose.
rental.deliveryFreeHelp: Leave empty if you charge from the first kilometre.
rental.deliveryRadiusHelp: Beyond this radius you and the renter agree directly.
rental.deliveryFeeHelp: Flat fee for one delivery within the radius above.
rental.mileageHint: Set a daily kilometre allowance; anything beyond it is recorded at settlement.
rental.mileageIncludedHelp: Already covered by the rental price.
rental.mileageExcessHelp: Only suggested at return — it is recorded once you confirm.
rental.termsHint: Spell out what you expect from renters. They read this before booking.
rental.termsPlaceholder: For example: no smoking in the car; return the vehicle at the agreed time.

images.title: Vehicle photos
images.intro: Upload photos from several angles to build trust. Clear photos get booked more often.
images.mainImageHelp: This photo represents the vehicle on the marketplace and in lists.
images.counterAria: Progress towards the minimum number of photos
images.missing: {count, plural, one {# more photo} other {# more photos}} needed to submit for review. You can still save a draft now.
images.enough: Enough photos to submit for review.

angles.side: Side profile, whole body in frame

success.submittedBody: We will check the listing and switch it on for renters.
success.draftBody: The vehicle is not on the marketplace yet. Finish it and submit whenever you are ready.
success.partialTitle: Vehicle saved, one part did not finish
success.partialBody: The vehicle already exists in your list — do not create it again. Open vehicle management to save the rest.
success.shopPendingTitle: Your host profile needs approval first
success.shopPendingBody: Vehicles can only go live after the platform approves your host profile.
